title: `DATEADD(MONTH)` clamps; `ADD_MONTHS` keeps month ends
description: `DATEADD(MONTH, 1, '2024-01-31')` is `2024-02-29`: a day past the month's end clamps. `DATEADD(MONTH, 1, '2024-04-30')` is `2024-05-30`, but `ADD_MONTHS('2024-04-30', 1)` is `2024-05-31`: `ADD_MONTHS` keeps the last day of a month as the last day. `+ INTERVAL '1 month'` clamps as `DATEADD`.
reference: `Time.addMonths` clamps to the end of a shorter month and keeps the day otherwise. sverify's SQL writes `DATEADD(MONTH, …)` (`writer-add-months`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT dateadd(MONTH, 1, a), add_months(a, 1), dateadd(MONTH, 1, b), add_months(b, 1), dateadd(MONTH, -1, c), add_months(c, 1), dateadd(YEAR, 1, d) FROM (VALUES ('2024-01-31'::DATE, '2024-04-30'::DATE, '2024-03-31'::DATE, '2024-02-29'::DATE)) AS s(a, b, c, d)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
